name: Typeform
description: Build beautiful, interactive forms that people love to fill out. Collect data, accept payments, and integrate with your favorite tools.

tools.name: Create Account Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a new workspace in a specific Typeform account. Use when you need to create a workspace within a particular account using the account ID.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the new workspace to create

inputs.name: account_id
inputs.about: The ULID format identifier for the account where the workspace will be created

tools.name: Create Form
tools.description: Tool to create a new Typeform form with customizable fields, logic, and settings. Use when you need to programmatically create a form with specific questions, welcome screens, thank you screens, and conditional logic.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Form type (quiz, classification, score, branching, etc.)

inputs.name: logic
inputs.about: Conditional logic jumps and variable calculations

inputs.name: theme
inputs.about: Theme reference

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Form title

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Array of field definitions for the form questions

inputs.name: settings
inputs.about: Form settings configuration

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.about: Workspace reference

inputs.name: welcome_screens
inputs.about: Introductory content screens shown before form fields

inputs.name: thankyou_screens
inputs.about: Completion screens shown after form submission

tools.name: Create Image
tools.description: Tool to upload a new image to your Typeform account via base64 encoding or URL. Use when you need to add images for forms or presentations. Either 'image' (base64) or 'url' parameter must be provided.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: Direct link to an existing image online. Either 'image' or 'url' must be provided.

inputs.name: image
inputs.about: Base64 code for the image (exclude data:image descriptors). Either 'image' or 'url' must be provided.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: The name assigned to your image file

tools.name: Create or Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook or update an existing one for a specified Typeform. Use when you need to configure webhooks to receive form response notifications at a specified URL.

inputs.name: tag
inputs.about: Unique webhook name you assign to identify this webhook

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: Webhook destination URL where form responses will be sent

inputs.name: secret
inputs.about: HMAC SHA256 signing key for payload verification. Use this to verify webhook authenticity

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.about: Whether to send responses immediately. Set to true to enable the webhook, false to disable it

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the form

inputs.name: verify_ssl
inputs.about: Whether to verify SSL certificates during webhook delivery. Set to false if using self-signed certificates

inputs.name: event_types
inputs.about: Event types that trigger the webhook (e.g., {'form_response_partial': True}). If not specified, defaults to form_response

tools.name: Create Theme
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom theme in Typeform with colors, fonts, background, and layout settings. Use when you need to create a theme for branding and styling Typeform forms.

inputs.name: font
inputs.about: Font choice from predefined Typeform options (e.g., 'Karla', 'Arial', 'Georgia'). This field is required by the API.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the theme

inputs.name: colors
inputs.about: Color configuration with answer, background, button, and question hex values. All color fields are required.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Field alignment (left/center) and font_size (small/medium/large). Both fields are required.

inputs.name: background
inputs.about: Background configuration for the theme.

inputs.name: rounded_corners
inputs.about: Border radius setting. Must be 'none', 'small', or 'large'

inputs.name: has_transparent_button
inputs.about: Whether the button should be transparent

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a new workspace in Typeform. Use when organizing forms into separate workspaces for teams or projects.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the workspace to create

tools.name: Delete Form
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Typeform and all of its responses. Use when you need to remove a form completely from the account.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier found in the form URL

tools.name: Delete Image
tools.description: Tool to delete an image from your Typeform account. Use when you need to remove an image that is no longer needed. Returns a success status once the image has been deleted (204 No Content).

inputs.name: image_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the image to remove

tools.name: Delete Responses
tools.description: Tool to delete specific responses from a Typeform by response IDs. Use when you need to remove response data from a form. Deletion is asynchronous - a 200 status means the deletion request was registered, not that deletion is complete. Maximum 1000 response IDs can be deleted per request.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier

inputs.name: included_response_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of response IDs to delete (max 1000 IDs). Example: 'id1,id2,id3'

tools.name: Delete Theme
tools.description: Tool to delete a theme from your Typeform account. Use when you need to permanently remove a theme. This operation cannot be undone.

inputs.name: theme_id
inputs.about: Unique theme identifier to delete

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook configuration from a specified Typeform form by its tag. On a successful response, the tool returns a success flag.

inputs.name: tag
inputs.about: Unique webhook name to delete

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier

tools.name: Delete Workspace
tools.description: Tool to delete a workspace from your Typeform account. Use when you need to remove a workspace. Note: The default 'My Workspace' cannot be deleted, and workspaces containing forms cannot be deleted (will return an error).

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Unique workspace identifier. Note: Default 'My Workspace' cannot be deleted, and workspaces containing forms cannot be deleted.

tools.name: Get About Me
tools.description: Get information about the owner account in Typeform.

tools.name: Get All Response Files
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a compressed archive containing all files that respondents uploaded for a specified form. Use when you need to download all file uploads from a Typeform form as a ZIP archive.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the form to download response files for

tools.name: Get Background By Size
tools.description: Request a Typeform background image at the default, tablet, mobile, or thumbnail size. The tool expects a JSON response with image metadata rather than returning image bytes.

inputs.name: size
inputs.about: Dimension preset for the background image. default: scaled to fit 1680x1050px, tablet: scaled to fit 1024x768px, mobile: scaled to fit 460x320px, thumbnail: scaled to fit 80x50px

inputs.name: image_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the image resource

tools.name: Get Choice Image By Size
tools.description: Request a Typeform choice image at a specified size. The tool expects a JSON response with image metadata rather than downloading image bytes.

inputs.name: size
inputs.about: Image size to retrieve. Options: 'default' (scaled to fit 230x230px), 'thumbnail' (cropped to 80x80px), 'supersize' (cropped to 310x233px), 'supermobile' (cropped to 238x164px), 'supersizefit' (scaled to fit 310x233px)

inputs.name: image_id
inputs.about: Unique ID for the image to retrieve

tools.name: Get Form
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific form's complete configuration including fields, logic, settings, and theme. Use when you need to get detailed information about a Typeform form.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier found in the form URL

tools.name: Get Form Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom messages for a Typeform including button labels, error messages, and UI text. Use when you need to get the current message configuration for a form.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier found in the form URL

tools.name: Get Form Responses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve form responses from Typeform with filtering by date, pagination, search, and response type. Use when you need to get responses for a specific form including timestamps of when users landed on and submitted the form. Note: Recent responses may take up to 30 minutes to appear.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort format: {fieldID},{asc|desc}. Example: 'field_123,asc'

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Pagination token for responses after this point

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Search string matched against all response fields

inputs.name: since
inputs.about: Filter responses from timestamp (ISO 8601 format like '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z' or Unix seconds)

inputs.name: until
inputs.about: Filter responses until timestamp (ISO 8601 format like '2023-12-31T23:59:59Z' or Unix seconds)

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Pagination token for responses before this point

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Limit displayed fields in answers section. Provide field IDs.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Maximum responses per request (default: 25, max: 1000)

inputs.name: response_type
inputs.about: Filter by type: 'started', 'partial', or 'completed'. Can specify multiple values.

inputs.name: answered_fields
inputs.about: Filter responses containing specified field IDs

inputs.name: excluded_response_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated response IDs to exclude

inputs.name: included_response_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated response IDs to include

tools.name: Get Image By Size
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an image in a specific size from Typeform. Use when you need to get a Typeform image optimized for different display contexts (default for desktop, mobile for mobile devices, or thumbnail for previews).

inputs.name: size
inputs.about: The desired image dimension. Options: 'default' (800px width), 'mobile' (460px width), or 'thumbnail' (80px×50px cropped)

inputs.name: image_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the image to retrieve

tools.name: Get Theme
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific theme's configuration including colors, fonts, and layout settings. Use when you need to get the design settings of a Typeform theme.

inputs.name: theme_id
inputs.about: Unique ID for the theme

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Retrieve a single webhook configuration by form ID and webhook tag. The webhook secret is redacted from the response.

inputs.name: tag
inputs.about: Unique name assigned to the webhook

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific workspace including its name, forms, and team members. Use when you need to get workspace details or check member access.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the workspace to retrieve

tools.name: List Forms
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all forms in your Typeform account with filtering, pagination, and sorting options. Use when you need to list, search, or browse forms across workspaces. Supports filtering by search terms, workspace, and sorting by creation or modification date.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination (default: 1)

inputs.name: search
inputs.about: Filters results containing the specified string in form titles or descriptions

inputs.name: sort_by
inputs.about: Field to sort results by: 'created_at' for creation date or 'last_updated_at' for last modification date

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Sort order: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of results per page (default: 10, maximum: 200)

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Filter forms by workspace ID to retrieve forms from a specific workspace

tools.name: List Images
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all images in your Typeform account in reverse-chronological order. Use when you need to list or browse available images.

tools.name: List Typeform Themes
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of Typeform themes and their styling configurations, including public and private themes. The tool declares the images:write scope.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number to retrieve (default: 1)

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of results per page, maximum 200 (default: 10)

tools.name: List Form Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all webhooks associated with a specified typeform. Use when you need to view webhook configurations for a form. Returns webhook IDs, URLs, enabled status, event types, and timestamps.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier for which to retrieve webhooks

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: List a page of workspaces in a Typeform account, optionally searching by name. Results include IDs and names and may include form counts and members.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

inputs.name: search
inputs.about: Search term to filter workspaces by name. Only workspaces matching this search term will be returned.

inputs.name: page_size
inputs.about: Number of items per page. Default is 10, maximum is 200.

tools.name: Patch Form
tools.description: Tool to partially update a Typeform using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify specific fields without replacing the entire form. Supports updating title, settings, theme, workspace, and other form properties.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier found in the form URL

inputs.name: operations
inputs.about: List of JSON Patch operations to apply to the form. Each operation specifies an action (add/remove/replace), a path to the field, and optionally a value

tools.name: Update Theme (Partial)
tools.description: Tool to partially update a Typeform theme by ID. Updates only the specified properties while leaving other theme settings unchanged. Each provided field must be complete (e.g., if updating colors, all color subfields must be provided). Cannot modify Typeform's public built-in themes.

inputs.name: font
inputs.about: Font family for the theme. Must be a valid Typeform font option.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the theme

inputs.name: colors
inputs.about: Colors configuration for the theme.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Configuration for fields or screens alignment and font size.

inputs.name: screens
inputs.about: Configuration for fields or screens alignment and font size.

inputs.name: theme_id
inputs.about: Unique ID for the theme to update

inputs.name: background
inputs.about: Background configuration for the theme.

inputs.name: rounded_corners
inputs.about: Rounded corners setting for the theme

inputs.name: has_transparent_button
inputs.about: Whether the button should be transparent

tools.name: Update Form
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Typeform by completely replacing its configuration. PUT request overwrites the entire form - any fields not included will be deleted along with their response data. Always retrieve the form first using Get Form, modify the desired properties, then send the complete updated form definition.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Form type category such as 'quiz', 'classification', 'score', 'branching', etc.

inputs.name: logic
inputs.about: Array of logic jump objects for conditional branching. Each contains: type (field), ref (field reference), and actions (array with action, condition, and details).

inputs.name: theme
inputs.about: Theme object containing 'href' field with theme URL to apply design styling to the form.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The form's title/name

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Array of form field objects defining questions and inputs. Each field must have: ref (unique reference), title (question text), type (field type like short_text, email, multiple_choice, etc.), properties (field-specific config), and optionally validations and attachments. Include all existing fields

inputs.name: hidden
inputs.about: Array of hidden field variable names for passing data via URL parameters.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier to update

inputs.name: settings
inputs.about: Form settings object including language, is_public, progress_bar, show_progress_bar, show_typeform_branding, autosave_progress, hide_navigation, captcha, redirect_after_submit_url, meta (with allow_indexing, description, image), and tracking properties.

inputs.name: variables
inputs.about: Variables object for tracking score, price, or enrichment calculations.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.about: Workspace object containing 'href' field with workspace URL. If not specified, form remains in current workspace.

inputs.name: welcome_screens
inputs.about: Array of welcome screen objects shown before the form. Each contains: ref, title, properties, and optionally attachment.

inputs.name: thankyou_screens
inputs.about: Array of thank you screen objects shown after form completion. Each contains: ref, title, type, properties (show_button, share_icons, button_mode, button_text), and optionally attachment.

tools.name: Update Form Messages
tools.description: Tool to update custom messages for form UI elements like buttons, errors, and placeholders in Typeform. Use when you need to customize the text displayed to form respondents.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier

inputs.name: label_button_submit
inputs.about: Text for the submit button (max 100 characters). This is the final button to submit the form.

inputs.name: label_error_required
inputs.about: Error message shown when a required field is empty (max 64 characters).

inputs.name: label_button_hint_default
inputs.about: Tooltip text for the continue button (max 28 characters). Use this to provide hints about the button's function.

inputs.name: block_short_text_placeholder
inputs.about: Placeholder text for short text input fields (max 100 characters).

inputs.name: label_button_no_answer_default
inputs.about: Text for the 'Continue without answering' button (max 100 characters). Shown when a question is optional.

tools.name: Update Theme
tools.description: Tool to update a theme's complete definition in Typeform. Use when you need to update all aspects of a theme including colors, fonts, and visual properties. This is a full update (PUT) operation that requires name, font, and colors to be provided. For partial updates, use PATCH instead.

inputs.name: font
inputs.about: Font family for the theme (required for PUT requests)

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Updated theme name

inputs.name: colors
inputs.about: Updated color palette with question, answer, button, and background colors

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Field settings for the theme

inputs.name: screens
inputs.about: Screen settings for the theme

inputs.name: theme_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the theme to update

inputs.name: background
inputs.about: Background settings for the theme

inputs.name: rounded_corners
inputs.about: Border radius style: none, small, or large

inputs.name: has_transparent_button
inputs.about: Whether buttons should be transparent

tools.name: Update Workspace
tools.description: Tool to update a workspace's name or manage team member access (add/remove members) in Typeform. Use when you need to rename a workspace or modify its member list using JSON Patch operations.

inputs.name: operations
inputs.about: List of patch operations to apply to the workspace. Each operation modifies a specific property.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Unique workspace identifier

tools.name: Upload Video
tools.description: Initiate a video upload to Typeform by obtaining a signed upload URL. Use this action to prepare for uploading a video file to a specific form field. After receiving the upload_url, use it to upload the actual video file via a PUT request.

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.about: Unique form identifier where the video will be attached

inputs.name: field_id
inputs.about: Field ID where the video media belongs within the form

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: ISO 639-1 format language code for automatic transcription (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish)
